blend.note: a NEW emergent culture, neither Ethiopian nor Anglo-Saxon - a savanna-highland realm of hill-fastnesses and a literate church-and-court, fusing the Ge'ez highland and the Anglo-Saxon hall; tongue, titles and gods are fused forms between the two parents.

_note: Cross-family DEEP BLEND (Ethiopian + Anglo-Saxon): a single emergent people of the high savanna - amba-fastnesses and hall-burhs, a literate church-and-court fusing the Ge'ez highland kingdom and the Anglo-Saxon mead-hall. Not backbone+overlay: the lexicon, titles and deity-names are genuinely fused (Ge'ez emphatics/-a + Old English th/ae/-ing). civ = feudal. Seeds/shifts across all three alignments. Common-word lexicon and rank titles fuse the real Ge'ez/Old-English registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are fused morphs of the Agrippan canon, never real gods.

phonology.palette: Fused Ge'ez-Old-English: emphatics t'/s'/q' meet th/ae; consonants t k s h n r w l m b g, sh, ch; vowels a e i o u + ae; endings fuse Ge'ez -a/-os with OE -en/-ing/-as; root stress.
phonology.phonotactics: CVC; gutturals and emphatics beside OE th/hw; -a and -ing endings.

morphology.patronymic_form: filiation Walda- (son of) fused with the OE -ing patronymic; the hagcyn (kindred); a church-name (baptismal) for the literate, an earned hall-name for warriors.
morphology.compounding_rule: [quality|feature](stem) + element: Tselim-deborg (black-mountain), Amba-burh (fastness-fort); the church-towns Bet-/-mynster; lineages -ingas.

title_ladder.government: feudal (a high-savanna kingdom: the Bretnegus over hall-thegns and amba-lords, a literate church-and-court of the Bet-mynster; the witan-council and the church advise)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Fused Ge'ez-Old-English ladder, ascending; the titles blend the two (Ge'ez shum/negash/dejazmach/ras/negus + OE thegn/mearc-weard/scir-gerefa/ealdor/cyning/bretwalda). Shethen (chief-thegn) barony; Marcnegash (march-warden) march; Scirmach (shire-commander) county; Heretoras (war-duke) duchy; Ealdras (high-lord) principality; Cynegus (king) kingdom; Bretnegus (high-king, king of kings) over the Bretnegusat. The church (the Bet-mynster) and the witan-council temper the crown. (Rank titles fuse the real Ge'ez/OE register, allowed.)
title_ladder.heir: Aetheling (the throne-worthy heir; Sa-Cynegus, king's son)

people_name_convention.order: given (theophoric or church-name) + Walda-/-ing filiation; the hagcyn (kindred); warriors an earned hall-name, the literate a church baptismal name.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the church-and-court use Ge'ez-style theophoric and church names; the hall-warriors Old-English dithematic names.
people_name_convention.theophoric: names from the fused deity-names + an element: Walda-X (son-of), Gabra-X (servant-of), or OE -wine/-red: e.g. Gabra-Thalros, Worland-wine.

religion._note: Deity-names are fused morphs of the Agrippan canon (Ge'ez + Old-English), never real Ethiopian/Germanic gods. Aethling seeds/shifts across all three alignments; its stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). A literate church-and-court (the Bet-mynster) keeps the high cult; the hall and the amba-grove keep the older rites; the honored dead are kept in the church-recital and at the burial-mound.
religion.the_one: Aethyarn (< Aeternus; fused Ge'ez Atyarna / OE Aetern) - God Most High; revered as the supreme maker when Lawful, set aside when Neutral, reviled as the far tyrant when Chaotic

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: revere the One (Aethyarn) and the Lawful powers (Thalros, Worland, Geyandos, Numanos), demonize the Chaotic powers (Maraxen, Waecidos, Lusanden)
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: venerate the Chaotic powers (the war-fire Maraxen and the wild hall-frenzy), demonize the Lawful powers and the One
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: all powers ambivalent; foreground the honored dead (the church-recital and the burial-mound) and the amba- and hall-spirits

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the demonized set (by current alignment) take dread epithets: when Lawful - Maraxus -> Maraxen the War-Fire; when Chaotic - Tulrius -> Thalros the Cold-Sun, Aeternus -> Aethyarn the Far Tyrant.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Bet-mynster (church-minster) of [power]: 'the Bet-mynster of Thalros'; the amba-grove keeps the older rite.
religion.saints_pattern: Qiddus/Halig [name] - the deified-just dead, royal saints and church-founders, kept in the recital and at the rock-hewn debr-mynster.

holy_symbol_motifs.Thalros: a rayed sun above the tablets and the cross-staff
holy_symbol_motifs.Worland: an iron spear crossed with an oath-ring
holy_symbol_motifs.Aethyarn: an all-seeing eye above the amba-fastness

banks_patterns.ships: highland realm - mule-trains and Red-Sea traders: 'Bringer of Itan', 'the Star of the Bahsae', 'the Oath' (Mehala)
banks_patterns.military_units: the [hall] Sefari-fyrd (host) / the [lord] Spears: 'the Sefari of Worland', 'the Amba-Wardens'
banks_patterns.taverns: the mead-hall and the tej-house: 'the Golden Hall', 'the Tej and Amba'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: ruined amba-fastnesses and rock-hewn mynsters: 'the Amba of [name]', 'the fallen Bet-mynster of [name]'
